changes.title: Runestone carving
items: The sigils carved on the runestones are bigger and sharper, glow brighter, and have a faint lit rim, so you can make them out from across a clearing at night

changes.title: Smaller map
items: The island is smaller: about 100 areas instead of about 200, so the forest is quicker to cross and runs more smoothly

changes.title: Setpieces crisp
items: Each area's set piece is drawn at the same pixel size as everything round it, not stretched into bigger, blurrier pixels
